messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T at 10¢: stacks ~57,500 sats a month, about $48, power runs ~$47 a month, and roughly a 0.22% shot at a block per year.
Looked up for Sarah: The 40T is our best value per TH at $19.98 — $799, 40 TH/s, 650 W; batch 5 ships November 14, date depends on the manufacturer.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T is 650 W on a normal wall socket, 15 lb, $40 flat shipping. No noise spec on file — don't quote decibels.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the Magic Miner 40T at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? If you want to answer out loud, tap the mic, or just listen.

At ten cents, the 40T stacks about fifty-seven thousand sats a month, and the power runs around forty-seven dollars. It's seven ninety-nine, and no unit we sell costs less per terahash. Want to add it to your setup?
Nice, then the 40T slots right in. It's seven ninety-nine, and it's our best value per terahash. What are you running now? (The call ended. 2 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
